dataset.title: Replication Data for: Does working from home work? Evidence from a Chinese experiment
dataset.deposit: Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/PZQOB1, version 1, released 2018-07-25, file WFH.zip (3,879,925 bytes, MD5 f02e914b1779714ce6bae090b46ff172)
dataset.access_note: The Dataverse file requires a guestbook response (guestbook 269); no guestbook was submitted. The ingest downloads the authors' own public copy, linked as 'Data' for this paper on https://nbloom.people.stanford.edu/research (a Google Drive file). It holds the replication set: 22 Stata files, Tables2014.do, the Stata log, Readme.txt and figure PDFs, plus macOS metadata entries that the ingest skips.
